Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server supports PostgreSQL minor versions (public preview)

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server (preview) now supports the latest PostgreSQL minor versions 13.2, 12.6, and 11.11. These Postgres versions have many security updates and bug fixes. As part of your maintenance window, your servers will be automatically updated to this version.

For more information on PostgreSQL versions supported with Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server, see the supported versions documentation,

For the list of supported regions where Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server (preview) is available, see supported regions.

Learn more.
